description: The bar chart, titled "Token Ratio (TR)," compares the performance of three models—RedWhale (our), Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. Each category displays three vertical bars representing the respective models, with their values labeled on top. The legend indicates that RedWhale (our) is represented by dark purple bars, Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 by light blue bars, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) by light gray bars. The vertical axis represents the token ratio, with values ranging from 0.42 to 1.00, and the horizontal axis lists the evaluation categories. In most categories, the SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model achieves a token ratio of 1.00, indicating a baseline performance. RedWhale (our) and Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 show varying performance, with RedWhale (our) achieving the highest values in KoBEST-CP (0.71) and KoBEST-SN (0.69), while Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 performs best in KoBEST-CP (0.74) and KoBEST-SN (0.73). The average token ratio (AVG) shows RedWhale (our) at 0.57, Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 at 0.61, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) at 1.00.
